facts.text: Nova Southeastern University's Dual Admission program lets undergraduates reserve a seat in an NSU graduate or professional program while earning a bachelor's degree and an annual $2,000 scholarship.

sources.title: Dual Admission | Undergraduate Admissions | Nova Southeastern ...
sources.quote: With Nova Southeastern University's Dual Admission program, you can reserve your seat in one of NSU's graduate or professional programs while you earn your bachelor's degree and receive an annual $2,000 scholarship.
